names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 martie, «Sfântul Ierarh Nicolae Velimirovici, Episcop al Ohridei și Jicei».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Νικόλαος Επίσκοπος Αχρίδος και Ζίτσης», with the rank word and the two sees left off. The body of the page adds the surname in brackets and in Greek letters, «Ο Άγιος Νικόλαος (Βελιμίροβιτς)».

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 20 апреля ст. ст., name page 13515, «Святитель Николай (Велимирович), епископ Охридский и Жичский», with the rank and the two sees left off; the line itself gives «Николая» and the sees and no surname at all. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'велимирович николаи' has no other holder.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Episcopul Nicolae s-a născut la 23 decembrie 1880, de praznicul Sfântului Naum al Ohridei, din părinți sârbi binecredincioși, Dragomir și Katarina Velimirovici, în satul Lelici».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «a adormit întru Domnul în țară străină, în anul 1956, în timp ce se ruga în chilia lui modestă de la Seminarul Ortodox „Sfântul Tihon” (America). Sfântul Episcop avea 76 de ani».

feast.note: The day the calendar gives him here is the translation of his relics: his life page heads «Дни памяти: 5 марта , 20 апреля (Перенесение мощей) , 30 августа (Серб.)», and the translation it describes is the carrying of his relics in 1991 from South Canaan to his native Lelić. One row per church is the schema, so the other two days are recorded here and he does not render on them; neither of those day pages was read.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 апреля ст. ст. — «Свт. Николая , еп. Охридского и Жичского (1956).»
source.note: The name page is 13515 and the life page life6916. The year on the line, 1956, is the year of repose this folder already carried. The line is followed on the page by a bare «(Серб.)», a marker of the Serbian local calendar standing on a line of its own, which the candidate scan reads as a twelfth entry and which is not a person. The day page prints no hymn under his name.

attestations.note: The Greek calendar keeps him on 5 Μαρτίου, where doxologia keeps him on 18 martie; the two churches differ on the day and each row records the day page it was read from. The page heads him «(1880 - 1956)», which is the pair of years this folder already holds. It gives his birth as 23 December 1880 in the village of Lelić in central-western Serbia, the first of the nine children of the pious farmers Dragomir and Katherine; his doctorates at Bern in 1908, Oxford in 1909 and Halle in 1911; seven languages, Greek among them; his tonsure and ordination to the presbyterate at the monastery of Rakovica near Belgrade in December 1909, after a vow made in a grave dysentery; his mission to America and England in 1915–1919; his election as bishop of Žiča in 1919 and his move to Ohrid in 1920; his arrest by the German occupation authorities in 1941 and his deportation to Dachau in 1944; his release in May 1945 and his refusal to return to a country whose regime thought him undesirable; his teaching at the seminary of the monastery of St Sava at Libertyville, Illinois, and his settling from 1951 at the Russian monastery of St Tikhon in Pennsylvania; his repose while praying in his cell on a Sunday morning in 1956, as he prepared to serve; and the return of his relics to Serbia in 1991. It prints no hymn.
The Romanian life says the Serbian Orthodox Church canonised him in 2003, but no Serbian calendar was read for him: pravoslavno.rs was not checked (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Propovăduitor cu limbă de aur al lui Hristos cel înviat, pururea călăuzitor al norodului sârb cel de Cruce purtător, alăută sunătoare a Sfîntului Duh, iubit de monahii ce întru tine se bucură, slava şi fala preoţilor, învăţător al pocăinţei, vlădică al tuturor neamurilor, dreptar celor din oastea lui Hristos în rugăciunile către Dumnezeu, Sfinte Nicolae, dascăl al Americii şi slavă a norodului sârb, împreună cu toţi sfinţii, roagă pe Unul iubitorul de oameni să ne învrednicească de veşnică pace şi bucurie în Împărăţia Sa cea cerească!

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Nicolae Velimirovici (the page prints no tone)

english.text: Golden-tongued herald of the risen Christ, unfailing guide of the cross-bearing Serbian people, sounding harp of the Holy Spirit, beloved of the monks who rejoice in thee, glory and boast of priests, teacher of repentance, bishop of all nations, rule of those in the army of Christ in their prayers to God: O holy Nicholas, teacher of America and glory of the Serbian people, entreat with all the saints the only Lover of mankind, that we may be counted worthy of eternal peace and joy in His heavenly Kingdom.
